author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Author combobox search does not match the displayed inverted author label.
findings.consequence: A user can see options rendered as surname-first labels such as `Strindberg, August`, but typing that visible label including the comma filters the matching author out because only `full_name` is searched.
findings.evidence: The option filter checks each term only against `author.full_name.toLocaleLowerCase("sv-SE")`. The direct template usage renders author options from `author.name_for_index`, so the visible label and searchable text differ. Existing behavior tests cover typing `Strindberg`, but not the displayed `Strindberg, August` form.
findings.recommendation: Build the author option haystack from both `author.full_name` and `author.name_for_index`, using the same token matching style as the catalog text filters.
